result.summary: The page appears visually intact overall. Edge-clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are excluded per instructions; the only notable concern is minor readability of small gray secondary text.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and restaurant details uses small light-gray text that may be hard to read for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size slightly and/or darken the gray to improve contrast against the white background.
